name: services/events/notifier_status
description: Get information on the status of the notifier.
brief_description: Get information on the status of the notifier.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • daemon_running - true if notification sending daemon is running correctly, false otherwise,
  • total_pending_events_count - number of all unprocessed events in the queue.
